articles.headline: Embiid posts triple-double as LeBron-less Sixers stay unbeaten
articles.description: Joel Embiid had a triple-double with LeBron James out, Jaylen Brown scored 27 points and the 76ers remained undefeated with a 127-116 win over the Bucks.

articles.headline: Embiid posts triple-double with LeBron out to keep 76ers perfect in 127-116 win over Bucks
articles.description: — Joel Embiid had a triple-double with LeBron James out, Jaylen Brown scored 27 points on his 30th birthday and the Philadelphia 76ers remained undefeated with a 127-116 win over the Milwaukee Bucks on Saturday night.

articles.headline: Giannis Antetokounmpo fouls out vs. Hornets as Heat tumble to 0-3
articles.description: The Heat fell to 0-3 after a 115-110 loss to the undermanned Hornets in which Giannis Antetokounmpo scored just 14 points before fouling out.

articles.headline: Brandon Miller scores 34 points as the Hornets beat the winless Heat 115-110
articles.description: — Brandon Miller scored 34 points and the Charlotte Hornets beat the winless Miami Heat 115-110 on Saturday, bouncing back from one of the worst losses in franchise history a night earlier.
